title_ja: Return Passが呼び出すaim処理の来歴
summary_en: Reading set for tracing the origin of the aim routine that the Return Pass helper calls.
question_ja: Return Passが呼び出すaim処理は、いつ、どのmoduleで作られたものか。sourceは呼び出し先の来歴を記録せず、索引は呼び出し関係を記録しない。両方とsymbol採番を突き合わせる必要がある。
question_en: Where did the aim routine called by the Return Pass helper come from? The source records no origin and the index records no call relation, so both plus the symbol numbering must be read together.
